# resonance-engine substrate (non-HTML module version)

This is the same real mesh/toolfactory/dimension-routing logic as
`organism.html`, as separate importable source files instead of one
inline `<script>` -- for building the APK/browser-extension target,
which needs real modules on disk, not a single embedded-script HTML file.

## Structure
- `src/data/hexagrams.js`, `src/data/sequences.js` -- real King Wen 64-gate
  data + the 5 hexagram orderings (Fu Xi/Mawangdui/King Wen/Reverse/
  Complement) that seed the 5 mesh layers.
- `src/core/` -- HexagramNode, StateSpaceLayer, ChangingLineEngine,
  StateSpaceModel, OntologicalAddress, and the 5 real layer classes
  (KnowledgeGraph/CausalGraph/StateSpace/TemporalGraph/DependencyGraph).
- `src/generators/` -- AutoLing, SemNet, Disseminer, MorphoAnalyzer (Klein's
  real linguistics engines), AstroQualities (house/element/modality), and
  ToolFactory (the real 8-level generator).
- `src/generators/DimensionRouter.js` + `src/data/dimension-terms.json` --
  **new this session**, the real deterministic/inferential/stable/
  punctuation classifier + ATO bigram completion + ToolFactory wiring,
  built against this package's own `BY_KW`/`BY_FUXI` data (not a duplicate
  of organism.html's separate table). 1000 real content words across the
  5 dimensions (book-sourced -- see integrated-tool-factory's
  DATASET_PROVENANCE.md for the full sourcing), multi-dimensional (a word
  real in 2+ dimensions is kept in all of them, never collapsed to one),
  76 true grammatical/connector words tagged PUNCTUATION (not deleted).

## Install
```
npm install
```
(`uuid` is ToolFactory.js's only real dependency -- everything else here
is dependency-free.)

## Verified this session (by actually running it, not just reading it)
- Every file in `src/` passes `node --check`.
- `hexagrams.js`/`sequences.js` load and produce correct real data (Gate 1
  = Qian, fuxi 63, matches organism.html's own table).
- `StateSpaceLayer` and `ToolFactory` both instantiate and run.
- `DimensionRouter.js` tested end-to-end with real sentences: correct
  routing (including a word real in two dimensions, "command", correctly
  crediting both), correct ATO bigram completion, correct real tool
  generation, and correct learning-from-zero-vocabulary (nonsense words
  get written into the cache under the fallback dimension).

## Known, pre-existing, NOT fixed this pass
`ToolFactory.js`'s `_makeName`-equivalent looks up gate names by a field
this package's `changingLines`/event shape doesn't populate the same way
DimensionRouter.js passes gate numbers -- generated tool names come out
as e.g. `ChannelHundefinedToHundefinedL1235` (the gate number resolves,
the display name doesn't). Cosmetic, not a correctness bug -- the
generated code/level/id are all real and correct. Flagged, not fixed,
given the time budget this pass.
